notes.title: UPDATE…who wooden want it? …is now live
notes.notes:
This update includes the addition of the following

Complete new player lobby system including:

•	Player select Rogue or Operative
•	Round Time selectable 5 min to 15 mins
•	Operative Radar on / off
•	Steam friend invite to game added

In Game play additions are

•	Two new maps Wooden Fort and Warehouse, well we wood want these
•	Random new Operative characters
•	New Rogue taunt system Press Q
•	Updated In game chat system
•	Ambient background sounds added
•	Background Music Added

notes.title: If Rogue goes to black screen on launch
notes.notes:
We have been advised by some users that they experience problems when launching for first time. If you experience this please note the following.

Start task Manager
Select tab marked Processes
Look in list for Rogue with (Not respomnding)
Right click 
Go to Set Pirority
Change to high or realtime

Happy Gaming
